ModMetaData.name: HugsLib - 1.7 Waylith Fix (Continued) — Original by UnlimitedHugs
ModMetaData.author: WorldLeader
ModMetaData.description:
HugsLib is a shared library required by many RimWorld mods.
This independent continued edition uses its own package ID and includes a dedicated RimWorld 1.7 Waylith fix: opening or publishing the log now falls back to Logs/Player.log when the former root-level Player.log path does not exist.
Do not enable this edition together with the original HugsLib. Mods that still declare UnlimitedHugs.HugsLib as a dependency may show a missing dependency warning and must update their dependency package ID.
Version: 12.0.0 + RimWorld 1.7 compatibility patch.
Original author: UnlimitedHugs.
HugsLib 是许多 RimWorld Mod 使用的共享前置库。
本独立续作版使用新的包 ID，并加入 RimWorld 1.7 Waylith 修复。当旧版根目录 Player.log 不存在时，打开或发布日志会自动使用 Logs/Player.log。
请勿与原版 HugsLib 同时启用。仍声明依赖 UnlimitedHugs.HugsLib 的 Mod 可能显示缺少前置警告，需要相应更新依赖包 ID。
版本：12.0.0 + RimWorld 1.7 兼容补丁。
原作者：UnlimitedHugs。
